column1: # Known divergences of the futureparity suites on the upstream Alertmanager
# core (build tag upstreamcore, ADR-019). scripts/upstream-core-gate.sh fails
# on any leaf test failure missing here, and on a "fails" entry that passed.
# Columns (tab-separated): test path, class, expectation, reason.
#   class a  AMP-only surface not decided yet (none left: UPSTREAM-API-UI
#            dropped each one and moved it to class d, see
#            tasks/archive/UPSTREAM-API-UI/research.md)
#   class b  the test pinned AMP's own core; upstream is the reference
#            (entries removed in UPSTREAM-CORE-REMOVAL: such tests were
#            deleted or now expect upstream behaviour)
#   class c  gap in AMP's upstream wiring (entries closed in
#            UPSTREAM-CORE-REMOVAL)
#   class d  upstream differs from a deliberate AMP choice; owner decision
#   fails    must fail; passing means the entry is stale
#   flaky    may fail or pass (timing); must still run
# Divergences the harness (internal/upstreamcore/contract/harness_test.go) evens out, so
# that no test shows them; scripts/upstream-core-gate.sh checks the first one
# against cmd/amp-upstream directly:
#   b  POST without Content-Type is 415 upstream (AMP accepted it). The
#      harness sets application/json, as Prometheus and amtool do.
#   b  /api/v2/alerts/groups trails ingest by about a millisecond (dispatcher
#      provider subscription). The harness waits for the posted alerts to
#      appear in groups before answering the POST.
